TestCleanup::test_cluster_cleanup_no_res.relevance: Cleanup live for vnodes; no-op for tablets (api/tasks.cc:69-73). #1239 closed. Key problem: RF=2 tables default to tombstone_gc mode 'repair' (tombstone_gc.cc:339), where gc_grace_seconds is ignored and tombstones are purged only up to the last repair time (tombstone_gc.cc:97+); the test never repairs, so tombstones written after bootstrap survive compaction and would shadow any stale data. dtest PR 7584 (068022d716) pinned 'immediate' mode only for RF=1 tests, not this one.
